notes: operatingIncome = 'Profit (loss) before taxation' throughout (PBIT not available in XBRL for 2015+, so pre-tax used consistently). Revenue: 2000-2003 UK GAAP 'Group turnover' (excl. joint ventures); 2004+ IFRS 'Total revenues and other income' (2004-2006 continuing operations, ex-Innovene). Visible discontinuity 2003->2004 from UK GAAP->IFRS and restatement. Figures from Q4/full-year results 6-Ks filed with SEC (as first reported, some later restated); 2015+ from SEC XBRL company concept (ifrs-full Revenue = total revenues and other income; ProfitLossBeforeTax). FY ends Dec 31.
